logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of metal-based drug was measured using the shake flask technology. Weigh 0.2 mg of the complexes 1-10 and place it in the sample tube, add 2 mL water and 2 mL octanol, and mix thoroughly on a shaker for at least 24 h. Remove 100 μL solution from aqueous phase and oil phase respectively, add 1 mL nitric acid for digestion overnight, remove 100 μL solution to 2.4 mL secondary water, and then detect the content of copper element in the sample by ICP-MS.
